newsitem.title: UK: European straight run fuel ends week quietly.
newsitem.headline: European straight run fuel ends week quietly.

text.p: Low sulphur straight run in NWE was broadly steady on Friday, but there was little discussion.
"Bits and pieces are being done, but very quietly," said one trader who saw some demand into Scandinavia.
Prices were pegged around $105-108 fob NWE.
E-4 also held in the mid $90s cif NWE.
In the Mediterranean, levels were close to the trades seen on Thursday when a 35kt 1.0 percent M-100 sold at high cif qutoes +$1.
"There's really no market for the low sulphur or M-40," said one dealer. M-40 in the Med was seen to have lost $2 or so to stand close to $90 cif Med.
